title: Occupational health check
what: Doctors check that your health suits the job. The doctors and tests depend on your profession.
why: Before starting a job, and then regularly if the work involves hazards, food, children, or transport.
duration: usually from 1 to 2 hours up to 1 to 2 days if tests are needed; the final report comes after all doctors

prepare.title: Referral
prepare.text: Bring the referral from your employer. It lists your job and workplace hazards.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: If a fasting blood test is needed, come in the morning without breakfast. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Allow extra time. There may be many rooms to visit.

bring: Your health record book, if your job needs one
Results of past checks and chest X-rays
steps: At the front desk, the referral is checked, and you get a route
You give samples for tests and have the needed scans
You see the doctors on the list
The panel chair issues the final report
feel: Usually nothing unpleasant, except the needle for a blood test
after: Give the report to your employer
If something is found, more tests will be ordered
The next check follows your employer's schedule

faq.a: Usually the employer. Check with them in advance.

faq.q: Can I be found unfit for work?
faq.a: Yes, if a condition gets in the way of that job. More often you are given time for treatment or tests.

reminders.text: Work medical tomorrow. Bring the referral and your ID. If you are giving blood, do not eat in the morning.
